data.title: Life Cycle of a Butterfly
data.instructions: Put the pictures in order from start to finish

stages.label: Egg
stages.imagePrompt: A tiny round egg resting on a green leaf
stages.description: A mama butterfly lays a tiny egg on a leaf. Inside the egg, a baby caterpillar is starting to grow.
stages.transitionToNext: The egg hatches and a tiny caterpillar crawls out

stages.label: Caterpillar
stages.imagePrompt: A fuzzy green caterpillar eating a green leaf
stages.description: The hungry caterpillar eats lots of leaves to grow big and strong. It sheds its skin as it gets bigger.
stages.transitionToNext: The caterpillar hangs upside down and makes a chrysalis

stages.label: Chrysalis
stages.imagePrompt: A green chrysalis hanging from a plant stem
stages.description: The caterpillar rests inside a special shell called a chrysalis. Magic is happening inside!
stages.transitionToNext: The chrysalis opens up and a butterfly comes out

stages.label: Butterfly
stages.imagePrompt: A bright colorful butterfly with big wings sitting on a flower
stages.description: A beautiful butterfly comes out with wet wings. Once its wings dry, it flies away to drink sweet nectar from flowers.
stages.transitionToNext: The adult butterfly lays new eggs on a leaf to start the cycle again

data.scaleContext: This complete cycle takes about 6 to 8 weeks from egg to butterfly

misconceptionTrap.commonError: Students often think the chrysalis is a sleeping bag where the caterpillar just takes a nap
misconceptionTrap.correction: The caterpillar is actually very busy changing its body inside the chrysalis to grow wings!
